resources.string: Your computer rings with your phone, and you talk through its microphone and speakers.
This phone has no Bluetooth, which calls on your computer need.
This phone cannot make phone calls.

Calls go over Bluetooth, as they do with a car or a headset. Pair your phone with your computer once: start pairing in link2linux on your computer, tap the notification that appears here, and check that both show the same code. From then on your computer shows incoming calls, and you can answer, decline and dial there.
Pair or unpair your computer, or choose what it may use.
Tapping the pairing notification starts pairing with your computer at once, instead of opening Bluetooth settings. Needs the Nearby devices permission.
Shown when your computer is ready to pair over Bluetooth for calls
Pair with %1$s to take calls on your computer
Tap to pair over Bluetooth, then check that your phone and your computer show the same code.
